dedupe_keys.name: simulated heating energy demand for two residential neighbourhoods

description: Simulated heating energy demand for two residential neighbourhoods is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Katia Ritosa (KU Leuven). The large-scale artificial dataset introduced in this research reflects the energy demands of two neighbourhoods and with some reasonable limitations mimics monitoring campaigns otherwise collected on-site from buildings in use. The monitoring campaigns are created using white-box simulation models for single-family houses representing typical neighbourhoods in Flanders. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
